$comment: Machine-readable e2e scenario manifest for AI agents. Each scenario maps to a spec file; agents may also execute steps manually with a browser tool and must capture the listed screenshots into output/screenshots/<project>/. Viewport projects: desktop-1280, tablet-768, mobile-360, iphone-safari (real WebKit engine, iPhone UA + touch).

scenarios.description: WCAG 2.1 AA axe checks of public, buyer, seller and admin routes in light and dark at all three viewport widths, including /search?q=dates and /seller/products/create. JSON attachments retain violations and manual-review findings; a11y-role-index screenshots capture every scanned route.

steps.note: seeded buyer; must be email-verified (seeders set email_verified_at)

steps.expect: order detail shows the Cancelled status after confirming cancellation

scenarios.description: Storefront chrome: product-card states (regular, discounted, frozen/halal, sold out, long name) snapshotted at 360/768/1280 in light and dark; category-nav states (default/hover/active/focus, no current item on home); WCAG contrast on price, old price, promo tag and nav text in both themes; footer trust strip, link groups, legal bar and sub-640px disclosures.

steps.expect: price is the strongest text; promo only on the -NN% tag; halal badge gated by category; sold-out card dimmed with tag
aria-current on the current category, 2px indicator, hover pill brand-50/700, 1px offset-2 focus ring; none active on /
contrast >= 4.5:1 for price, old price, tag, nav text in light and dark
trust strip, 5 link groups + brand block, legal bar; disclosures below 640px with aria-expanded

scenarios.description: Seller application lifecycle: error summary on empty submit, PSGC cascading selects with auto-filled postal code, file uploads (logo PNG, permit/cert PDFs), certificate add/remove, client-side checklist completion, submit into pending state, admin requests changes (item flagged, shop changes_requested), seller sees the note and resubmits, admin approval via the moderation queue (type=shop_application) behind a confirm dialog, and the applicant entering the seller workspace. Once approved, /seller/register 404s for the applicant.

steps.note: fresh user per project run so the apply → changes → resubmit → approve flow is exercised for real

steps.expect: danger Banner summary visible and focused, error links jump to fields

steps.note: PSGC selects region→province→city→barangay, postal auto-filled+locked from city, uploads via input[type=file]
steps.expect: checklist items turn done
pending Banner 'Application under review'
Request changes opens a dialog with a required message; sending it flags the item and returns to the queue
'Changes were requested' banner shows the admin's note; PSGC and uploads must be redone; resubmit returns to 'Application under review'
resubmitted item is pending again; Approve asks for confirmation, then decides it and returns to the queue
approved applicant reaches the seller workspace instead of bouncing to /seller/register
public terms page: h1, version line, draft warning banner, TOC anchors
